container_context.declared_input_hash: provenance.inputs_sha256 must be a64-character lowercase hexadecimal string; check declaration format only, not equality with an unopened companion
container_context.properties: list of at most512 dicts; each has a string name; root/schema/context/container mismatches stop with first closed reason

exact_numbers.definition: A finite JSON number token denotes exactly sign*integer-mantissa*10^(explicit-exponent-fractional-digit-count). No binary float conversion, bool/string coercion, unit conversion or physical inference. Preserve original token including signed zero in private output.
exact_numbers.finite_meaning: All syntactically valid JSON decimal number tokens with finite integer exponent denote finite rationals. Limits are engineering scope, not a physical range. No observed data may change these bounds automatically.
exact_numbers.out_of_limit: Categorical NUMBER_OUTSIDE_ENGINEERING_LIMIT, with exact original token retained privately; no numeric approximation or inference of physical impossibility.
exact_numbers.unselected_numeric_tokens: Strict JSON syntax only; machine exposed but never projected or numerically evaluated.

exposure: Every raw mixed JSON byte/token/property is machine exposed on read/parse, not just the144 selected positions. Private selected labels/citations and declared input hashes are historical target-bearing data; no fresh holdout. All partial byte-read, parse and projection progress remains explicit.
first_failure: Global stop preserves first closed source/parser/context error. Later cleanup/write failure is separate; never erase earlier failure or any private write exposure.

frame.choice: UNKNOWN; all existing edges retained only as context, not selected references

invocation: No invocation at import. Future fixed manifest binds self/input/frame/source pins; exclusive fixed output reservation before target access. One exact-size-plus-one read per fixed object; verify size/SHA256/Git blob on same immutable bytes. No retry/fallback/network/upstream loaders. Actual manifest/invocation remain root-owned and absent now.

label_classification.all_pairs_complete: Only if all144 scoped positions have one record, expected unit and two valid exact numbers; citation and tolerance statuses reported separately. This is recorded-label completeness only, never a performance/science pass.
label_classification.citation: MISSING / NULL / INVALID_TYPE / EMPTY / WHITESPACE_ONLY / NONEMPTY_STRING; literal strings only privately, no adequacy/source-choice inference
label_classification.property_record: ABSENT / SINGLE / AMBIGUOUS; duplicates never silently selected, all matching records preserved privately under the same scoped position
label_classification.tolerance: Separate optional field; same numeric categories plus NEGATIVE; missing/null allowed. Negativity determined exactly from sign and nonzero mantissa; -0 is nonnegative. Not used to fill labels or as uncertainty.
label_classification.unit: Only literal eV for vacancy and J/m^2 for each gamma property; missing/null/nonstring/mismatch separate categories

parser: One strict bounded recursive JSON grammar pass per immutable object; reject duplicate decoded keys, nonstandard constants, malformed UTF8/JSON and lone surrogate codepoints. Number tokens preserved exactly without conversion. String decoder allocation is bounded by source cap before tighter decoded-string check.
private_output: Complete36ID/144position projection after every file passes source/container/context checks. Per-position absent/invalid/ambiguous states are preserved rather than made into global parser failures. On global failure no private projection returned/written, but all partial exposure/materialization remains recorded.
public_output: Only original identities/graph and closed categorical label/unit/citation/tolerance/provenance states plus progress counts. No new raw numerical lexemes/citations/input hashes or arbitrary strings.

raw_source_objects.excluded: Both reference containers, all unbound evidence/run objects, binding reports and every unlisted object.

scientific_limits: Actual reference choice UNKNOWN even if labels are complete
Non-null annotations may predate binding and do not prove selection by this binder
No reference comparison or matching, binder preference, residual/rank/fit/split/census performance calculation
NOT_ADMITTED for all outcomes; no physical truth or source-compatibility claim
Optional tolerance remains an acceptance-policy annotation, not metrological uncertainty
